description: A California family-law judgment (FL-180) with its Spousal, Partner, or Family Support Order Attachment (FL-343) ordering spousal support (alimony)

court.description: The superior court and county, e.g. 'Superior Court of California, County of ...'

case_number.description: The case number printed in the caption

judgment_type.description: What the judgment is for, as checked: dissolution, legal separation or nullity

is_stipulated.description: True if the judgment is a stipulated judgment

marital_status_ends.description: The date marital or domestic partnership status ends, as YYYY-MM-DD

jurisdiction_acquired.description: Item 3: the date the court acquired jurisdiction of the respondent, as YYYY-MM-DD

former_name_restored.description: Item 4f: the former name restored to a party, if any

children.description: Item 4i: the children of the marriage

spousal_support_by_fl343.description: Item 4l(3): true if spousal support is ordered as set forth in the attached FL-343

pages_attached.description: Item 5: the number of pages attached

support_order.description: The Spousal, Partner, or Family Support Order Attachment (form FL-343)

attached_to.description: The form this attachment is attached to, as checked, e.g. 'Judgment (form FL-180)'

petitioner_gross_monthly_income.description: Item 1a: the petitioner's total gross monthly income

petitioner_net_monthly_disposable_income.description: Item 1a: the petitioner's net monthly disposable income

respondent_gross_monthly_income.description: Item 1b: the respondent's total gross monthly income

respondent_net_monthly_disposable_income.description: Item 1b: the respondent's net monthly disposable income

computer_calculation_attached.description: Item 2: true if a computer calculation of the parties' financial circumstances is attached

marriage_length_years.description: Item 3b: the length of the marriage, in years

marriage_length_months.description: Item 3b: the additional months of the marriage, if any

payor.description: Item 6a: who must pay support, 'petitioner' or 'respondent'

support_type.description: Item 6a: the kind of support, as checked: spousal, family or partner support

is_temporary.description: Item 6a: true if the support is temporary

monthly_amount.description: Item 6a: the support amount per month

start_date.description: Item 6a: the date support begins, as YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: Item 6a: the date support is payable through, as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if none is given

payable_day.description: Item 6a: the day of the month support is payable, as printed, e.g. '1st'

earnings_assignment_issued.description: Item 6c: true if an earnings assignment for the support will issue

earnings_assignment_stayed.description: Item 6d: true if service of the earnings assignment is stayed
